ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% of visible surface area consists of high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes, while 35% consists of low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region exhibits a broad, contiguous white zone; the trailing edge is defined by a continuous band of black pigmentation (~10-20 pixels deep); distal tips (left and right) are predominantly black with irregular mottled transitions into the white central areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge; topography is characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys; a particularly deep irregular indentation is located on the outer-third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical concave upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (1-3 pixels in diameter) visible against the high-intensity white background on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on both lobes; specifically, two parallel dark lines on the mid-left lobe and at least three distinct unaligned marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks across ventral surfaces; significant jagged irregular loss of material along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced and jagged serration pattern along the distal trailing edges, particularly the right side.
